simple.meaning: פִּיפִיָּה (pîyphîyâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “an edge or tooth.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פִּיפִיָּה (H6374) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 149:6, with occurrences in Psalms, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פִּיפִיָּה (H6374) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פִּיפִיָּה (H6374) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: פִּיפִיָּה (pîyphîyâh) / H6374 is traced through Psalms 149:6, Isaiah 41:15 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
